# Maine High School Sports — Bangor Daily News

> Scores, schedules, and the latest sports stories for Maine high school
> athletics. The rendered page (index.html) is a client-side React app with
> no server-rendered HTML — an agent that only reads HTML will see an empty
> `<div id="root">`. Everything the page shows is built from the plain JSON
> files linked below; fetch those directly instead of trying to scrape the
> rendered page.

All paths are relative to this page's own directory (this file lives at
`bangordailynews.com/maine-sports/llms.txt`; the JSON files are siblings of
it, e.g. `bangordailynews.com/maine-sports/data/schedules.json`).

Data refreshes twice daily (~7 a.m. and ~9 p.m. US/Eastern). Every file
carries its own `last_updated` (ISO 8601, UTC) — check that before assuming
freshness rather than caching indefinitely.

## Data

- [data/schedules.json](data/schedules.json): The primary schedule/results
  file — every Maine high school game this season, one entry per event.
  `{last_updated, season, games: [...]}`. `season` is one of "fall" /
  "winter" / "spring". Each game:
  ```json
  {
    "game_id": "59974",
    "date": "2026-09-14",
    "time": "4:00 PM",
    "type": "League",
    "status": "Normal",
    "level": "Varsity",
    "home": "Central",
    "away": "Stearns Sr.",
    "site": "Central HS",
    "sport": "Field Hockey",
    "gender": "Girls",
    "home_score": 1,
    "away_score": 12
  }
  ```
  Notes:
  - `status` is one of "Normal" / "Postponed" / "Canceled". `time` is a
    display string ("4:00 PM") and is literally "Postponed" when
    `status == "Postponed"` — don't parse it as a clock time without
    checking `status` first.
  - `home_score`/`away_score` are only present once the game is final. A
    game with a past `date` but no score fields is not necessarily
    unplayed — it may be a multi-team event (see below) that doesn't
    resolve to a single winner/loser pair.
  - A "game" isn't always a two-team dual match. Cross country meets, golf
    invitationals, and similar events can field many schools at once; for
    those, `home` is whichever school (if any) hosted, and `away` is every
    other participant as one comma-separated string — not a real list. If
    you need the actual per-school breakdown for a multi-team event, use
    `data/mpa_games.json` instead (same events, `teams` kept as a real
    array rather than flattened into home/away).
  - `gender` is "Boys" / "Girls" / "Coed", or "" if genuinely unknown (rare
    — most sports have a resolved gender even when the source feed's own
    label omits it for a single-gender sport).

- [data/mpa_games.json](data/mpa_games.json): The same underlying events as
  schedules.json, unflattened. `{last_updated, games: [...]}`. Each game has
  the same top-level fields as above (minus `home`/`away`/`home_score`/
  `away_score`) plus:
  ```json
  {
    "teams": [
      {"school": "Edward Little", "home_away": "Home", "result": "", "score": null},
      {"school": "Oxford Hills", "home_away": "Away", "result": "", "score": null}
    ]
  }
  ```
  `result` is "Win" / "Loss" / "Tied" once final, else "". `score` is an
  integer once final, else `null`. Use this file, not schedules.json, when
  you need every participant in a multi-school event rather than a
  home/away pair.

- [data/featured.json](data/featured.json): Latest articles published in
  BDN's Sports section (not just Maine high school sports — the whole
  section). `{last_updated, articles: [...]}`. Each article:
  ```json
  {
    "title": "Boston Bruins, UMaine hockey alums to square off in Robbins Lumber benefit Saturday",
    "url": "https://www.bangordailynews.com/2026/09/18/sports/college-ice-hockey/boston-bruins-umaine-hockey-alums-charity-game-robbins-lumber/",
    "byline": "Larry Mahoney",
    "image": "https://i0.wp.com/bdn-data.s3.amazonaws.com/uploads/2026/09/UMaine-Hockey-Student-Fans-LCO.jpg?fit=1024%2C595&ssl=1",
    "pub_date": "Fri, 18 Sep 2026 20:36:10 +0000"
  }
  ```
  `pub_date` is RFC 2822 (as delivered by the source RSS feed), newest
  article first. `image` may be an empty string if the story has no lead
  image; `byline` may be empty for wire/unbylined content.

## Not available here

- **Standings, classification/division groupings, and tournament
  brackets/seeding** are not in this dataset — this page links out to
  <https://www.mpa.cc/> (the Maine Principals' Association's own site) for
  that rather than re-hosting it. If you need a team's official rank,
  record-with-index, or bracket position, fetch it from mpa.cc directly;
  it isn't derivable from the files above.
- **Individual athlete results** (times, marks, places) aren't tracked here.
- There is no query/filter API — every file above is the *complete* current
  dataset for its scope, unfiltered. Filter client-side after fetching.

## Source

Repository: <https://github.com/dsmacleod/bdn-sports-page> — `scraper/`
holds the two feed parsers (`mpa_feed.py` for the official MPA game sync
feed, `featured.py` for BDN's Sports RSS feed) that produce the JSON above;
read those for the authoritative field-by-field parsing logic if this
document and the actual data ever disagree.
